units.function: Embedded-Postgres service/route tests for per-user inbox dismiss/snooze/restore and timestamp-based badge resurfacing across Approvals, join requests and failed Runs.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest/Supertest -> dismissal routes/service and sidebar badge service -> real Drizzle/PostgreSQL; authentication and referenced-entity authorization are not exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Company/user/itemKey Dismissal with kind/dismissedAt/snoozedUntil, Approval, join request, failed/timed-out Run and aggregate inbox/sidebar badge counts.
units.lifecycle: Upsert personal dismissal or future snooze -> suppress item while item updatedAt is not newer -> resurface on later activity -> delete dismissal to restore.
units.testAssessment: All 3 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs due unavailable embedded PostgreSQL. The source proves a compact projection rule but leaves entity validation, authorization, audit, typed keys, concurrency and mandatory-approval visibility untested.
units.designRationale: Let each human tidy a mixed attention queue without mutating underlying approvals/requests/Runs and automatically restore attention when an item changes after it was dismissed.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs personal queue presentation state that never changes business responsibility, cannot permanently hide mandatory approvals/exceptions and resurfaces deterministically when material evidence or risk changes.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the separate personal projection, idempotent upsert, reversible restore and activity-driven resurfacing. Replace free-form keys/timestamps with typed AttentionItemRef plus source version/risk class, cap snooze by policy, disallow permanent suppression for mandatory approvals and record a safe immutable receipt for high-risk dismiss/snooze actions.
units.responsibilityConflict: A human can hide approval and failure attention indefinitely without reason or durable receipt in this unit. The underlying responsibility object remains, but the Agent Boss queue may no longer surface a required action, undermining operational accountability.
units.securityFindings: HIGH mandatory-attention risk: Approvals/failures can be dismissed or snoozed to 2099 with no risk-class policy. HIGH reference-integrity gap: free-form itemKey existence/tenant/type is untested. HIGH audit gap: dismiss/snooze/restore has no asserted activity receipt. HIGH authorization gap: identity is injected and cross-company cases are absent. MEDIUM ordering gap: wall-clock updatedAt controls resurfacing. MEDIUM verification gap: all database tests skipped locally.
